verdict.rationale: Codex's own docs say it runs tasks in isolated cloud environments where you configure the dependencies, tools, variables, and setup steps each repository needs. The CLI can also submit work to a configured environment. The evidence is short first-party marketing-level statements, without detail on how environments are defined or kept reproducible. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the environment configuration format and setup-script mechanics, explicit evidence of reproducibility (e.g., pinned images or caching across runs), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs

citations.quote: Configure the dependencies, tools, variables, and setup steps each repository needs.
Run tasks in isolated cloud environments
submit work to a configured environment, and apply the result to your local repository from the terminal.
